items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And Clift Jackson was here on the piano, because I got both of their autographs.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
And incidentally, John Kirby was playing the bass with the band that night. And Clift Jackson was here on the piano, because I got both of their autographs.
I didn't know one musician from the other at that time. We had a lot of bands coming through.
